candidates.purpose: Confirm official CLI names without renaming by typo or enthusiasm.
Allow a valid identity anchor with name and role while gender and hope remain deferred.
Separate slot-55 candidate evidence from official induction claims.
Commit sanitized receipts instead of noisy CLI stderr, auth HTML, or telemetry warnings.
Use Codex exec resume for identity probes while preserving read-only constraints.
Use Kimi print-mode resume probes for compact continuity receipts.
Classify MCP/plugin startup warnings separately from task failure.
Queue provider live writes for operator confirmation instead of spending by momentum.
Derive v121 from the v120 receipt head and prior green suite counts.
Record started, queued, deferred, and completed states distinctly.
Ground CLI use-case planning in current official docs and local CLI help.
Keep Drive writes held unless the destination and action pack are approved.
Block provider spend unless a narrow spend pack is approved.
Queue merge/delete candidates before touching manifest rows.
Route large speculative plans into candidate packs instead of bloating core truth surfaces.
Keep GMUT claims labeled as formal, speculative, simulated, or externally evidenced.
Give CLI lanes bounded tasks and require Aletheon approval before changes.
Permit compact batches only when every phase leaves separate receipts.
Do not run Deep or L5 until concrete v121 implementation exists.
Publish only after curated staging, diff checks, secret scan, and remote equality receipt.
